author: Akien
prose: so lets talk first about the cairn command... it's intentions were supposed to include that it's the command line version of the bus in one way. oh crap, i just came up with a new feature that i think we really need... we had a conversation yesterday about which terminal something comes from. I've got it, and it relates to our current issue: we mod the user's .bashrc or windows equivalent, we set CAIRN_OPERATOR= this can be OPERATOR or Akien or whatever... Akien is a subclass of operator, and mostly this gets used for reporting... but when we use cairn superclaude or cairn cc0 or cairn librarian or whatever... anything but operator or operator shortcuts... we also set the otherwise unset variable CAIRN_USER= which can be librarian or cc0 or whatever. if CAIRN_USER is set, then it's you... if it's not, then it's me.
